dialogue.content: 時間になりましたので、ロールプレイを始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: It's time, so let's begin the role-play session. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, you too.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 本日のご相談内容と、差し支えなければ、年齢と性別をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what brings you in today and, if you don't mind, your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 休み明けに学校に行きたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to go back to school after the break.
16, male.

dialogue.content: 夏休み明けで、学校に行きたくないのですね
dialogue.English: So after summer break, you don't feel like going to school.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくない理由は思い当たりますか？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular reason you can think of for not wanting to go to school?

dialogue.content: 授業が面倒くさいです
dialogue.English: Classes are a hassle.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。授業のどんなところが面倒くさいのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What is it about the classes that you find to be a hassle?

dialogue.content: 面白くありません
dialogue.English: They're not interesting.

dialogue.content: 学校の授業が面白くないんですね
dialogue.English: So you find your school classes uninteresting.

dialogue.content: 学校の授業、全部が面白くないのかな？
dialogue.English: Do you find all of your classes uninteresting?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 例えば、特に面白くないものはありますか？
dialogue.English: For example, are there any you find particularly uninteresting?

dialogue.content: 多すぎて答えられません
dialogue.English: There are too many to name.

dialogue.content: 体育とかはどうですか？
dialogue.English: What about P.E., for example?

dialogue.content: なぜ体育なのですか
dialogue.English: Why P.E.?

dialogue.content: 体を動かすのは好きな人もいるので、聞いてみたんです。
dialogue.English: Some people enjoy physical activity, so I thought I'd ask.

dialogue.content: 私は好きではないのですが
dialogue.English: Well, I don't.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。授業が面白くないのは、なぜでしょう。例えば、先生がきらいとか？
dialogue.English: I see. Why do you suppose the classes are uninteresting? For example, is it that you don't like the teachers?

dialogue.content: なぜと言われても、、
dialogue.English: It's hard to say why...

dialogue.content: 答えにくい質問でしたね
dialogue.English: That was a difficult question to answer, wasn't it?

dialogue.content: じゃあ、学校に行きたくないのが、授業が面白くないからと言われてましたね
dialogue.English: Well, you mentioned that you don't want to go to school because classes are uninteresting.

dialogue.content: 学校を面白いと感じたことはないですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever found school interesting?

dialogue.content: あんまりないです
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 今、16歳でしたね
dialogue.English: You're 16 now, right?

dialogue.content: 高校1年生？
dialogue.English: First year of high school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないと思ったのは、今が初めてですか？
dialogue.English: Is this the first time you've felt you don't want to go to school?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: いつ頃に思ったのか聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me when you started feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 小学生くらいからです
dialogue.English: Since about elementary school.

dialogue.content: そんなころからなんですね
dialogue.English: Since that long ago.

dialogue.content: その時は、なにか気になることがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: Was there something bothering you at that time?

dialogue.content: はっきりとは覚えていません
dialogue.English: I don't remember clearly.

dialogue.content: 小学生の時には、学校に行くことはできていたんですか？
dialogue.English: Were you still able to go to school during elementary school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なんか、もやもやして行きたくなかったけど、なんとか行っていた感じなのかな？
dialogue.English: So it was something like, you had this vague feeling of not wanting to go, but you managed to go anyway?

dialogue.content: そんなところです
dialogue.English: Something like that.

dialogue.content: 中学生のころも、同じようなかんじですか？
dialogue.English: And was it similar in junior high?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、授業が面白くなかったから？
dialogue.English: Again, because the classes weren't interesting?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: 授業が嫌い、面白くないと思ったきっかけは、何か思い当たることがあるのかな？
dialogue.English: Can you think of anything that might have triggered your dislike for classes, or your feeling that they're uninteresting?

dialogue.content: きっかけも何もそのまま感じたことですよ
dialogue.English: There was no trigger; it's just how I've always felt.

dialogue.content: 面白い授業って、今まで経験したことがなかったということかな？
dialogue.English: So does that mean you've never experienced a class that you found interesting?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 学校では、授業の他にもいろんな行事があると思うけれど
dialogue.English: I imagine there are various events at school besides classes.

dialogue.content: そういうのは、どうでしたか？
dialogue.English: How were those for you?

dialogue.content: それも同じです
dialogue.English: It was the same for those, too.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくない理由は、授業が面白くないだけでなく、学校そのものが面白くないということなのかな？
dialogue.English: So the reason you don't want to go may be not just that classes aren't interesting, but that school as a whole isn't interesting to you?

dialogue.content: それもあるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That might be part of it.

dialogue.content: いま、何をしている時が楽しいのかな？
dialogue.English: What do you enjoy doing these days?

dialogue.content: 家でゲームしてる時です
dialogue.English: When I'm playing games at home.

dialogue.content: 夏休み中は、ほとんどゲームしてすごしてたの？
dialogue.English: Did you spend most of your summer vacation playing games?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなゲームが好きなのかな？
dialogue.English: What kinds of games do you like?

dialogue.content: 課題もやってましたが
dialogue.English: I did my assignments too, though.

dialogue.content: rpgです
dialogue.English: RPGs.

dialogue.content: 夏休みの課題は、しっかりやってたんですね？
dialogue.English: So you did all your summer vacation homework properly?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、課題は全部できたの？
dialogue.English: By the way, did you finish all of them?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すごいね、勉強は、得意なのかな？
dialogue.English: That's impressive. Are you good at studying?

dialogue.content: それはわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm not sure about that.

dialogue.content: 塾とかは、行ってるの？
dialogue.English: Do you go to a cram school or anything like that?

dialogue.content: 行ってません
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないということ、
dialogue.English: You mentioned not wanting to go to school,

dialogue.content: だったんですが、
dialogue.English: but I was wondering,

dialogue.content: 高校にいこうと思ったのは、何か目標とかあったのかな？
dialogue.English: when you decided to go to high school, did you have any goals in mind?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 将来、こんなことがしたいとかは？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you'd like to do in the future?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 好きなものは、ゲームのほかにもありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any interests besides games?

dialogue.content: ありません
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: ゲームがすきなんですね？そういう方面は興味あるのかな？
dialogue.English: So you really like games, right? Are you interested in that field?

dialogue.content: その方面は興味ありません
dialogue.English: I'm not interested in that field.

dialogue.content: というかこれ何の話してるんです？
dialogue.English: Wait, what are we even talking about?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないということは、逆に行かないと何か困ることがありますか？
dialogue.English: You've said you don't want to go to school—conversely, would there be any problems for you if you didn't go?

dialogue.content: 行かない理由がないからです
dialogue.English: Because there's no reason not to go.

dialogue.content: 用事があるので失礼します
dialogue.English: I have something to do, so I have to go.

dialogue.content: 分かりました。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 今日は、お時間もないようですので、これで終了いたします。また、お時間のある時に、お話を聞かせてください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: It seems you're out of time today, so we'll end here. Please feel free to talk with me again when you have more time. Thank you for the consultation.

dialogue.content: クライアント役、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for playing the client role.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: いろいろと勉強になりました。これから、もっと精進していきます。
dialogue.English: I learned a lot from this. I'll strive to improve further.

dialogue.content: これで終了いたします
dialogue.English: This concludes our session.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.
